opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research; host institution must administer; funds cannot be used for salary, conference attendance, or commercial gain.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to develop new educational resources or conduct educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalise projects; physiological in nature; host institution must administer; funds for consumables, equipment, animal costs; cannot support salary or conference attendance.
opportunities.summary: Supports pilot studies, technique development, and knowledge transfer activities in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supported by a Society Representative or Fellow; events must occur after the application window; cannot support salary, conference attendance; must display Society logo.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, symposia, seminars, or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members; funds for consumables, training, equipment; cannot support salary costs.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for postdoctoral researchers requiring additional assistance to achieve their full potential.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer; funds for activities addressing EDI principles; cannot support salary or conference attendance.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion within the physiological sciences.
